source_snapshot.items: All SAS/SATA NVMe LED Check - Present
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert NVMe SSD in backplane and inspect Present LED.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires literal NVMe Present semantics, stable slot mapping, safe insertion and physical evidence.

old_problem: SAS/SATA taxonomy obscured an explicit NVMe Present-LED procedure, while DeepSeek proposed different Locate/raw indicators.
disposition_reason: Items suffix and Procedure explicitly identify NVMe insertion and Present LED; SAS/SATA is legacy grouping, not an alternate target. Exact OEM Present state, topology and insertion support are project inputs. Locate/raw control is excluded because it tests another LED state.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row113 all18 XLSX cells and history2721.
Preserved literal insertion-triggered Present/power LED and physical observation.
Rejected Locate/raw IPMI substitution; no insertion, LED or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized NVMe insertion-triggered Present/power LED validation
test_case.purpose: Verify insertion and detection of the approved NVMe SSD produces the platform-defined physical Present/power LED state in the mapped backplane bay.
required_package: Supported hot-swap versus powered-off insertion procedure
Qualified operator, ESD/power controls and physical photo/video evidence
OS/boot/mount/RAID/data exclusions, detection timeout and restoration policy
test_case.test_command: Operator follows the approved power/hot-swap and ESD procedure to insert the exact mapped NVMe SSD. Capture timestamped bay/serial and Present/power LED evidence from absent through detected steady state; read-only agent collection correlates controller/sysfs/NVMe stable identity and logs. Do not issue Locate, rebuild or undocumented raw LED commands.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped SSD is detected in the expected topology and its physical Present/power LED reaches the exact OEM-specified state/timing without storage or platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires stable SSD-to-bay identity, supported insertion/detection and genuine physical Present LED evidence. Locate/raw IPMI or another indicator cannot pass.
safety_gate: Physical insertion is qualified-operator work with approved power/ESD method.
Protect OS/boot/mounted/RAID/data devices and verify stable identity.
Do not hot-insert unless platform specification permits it.
Abort on wrong slot/device, detection timeout, PCIe/media error or unexpected LED; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: OEM Present LED table and insertion authority
test_case.recovery: On wrong identity, missing detection or unexpected LED, stop further handling, preserve bay/serial/controller/kernel/photo evidence, use only the approved power/hot-swap procedure to restore baseline, and require storage/backplane owner review before reinsertion.

source_conflict.reason: Literal NVMe suffix/procedure is authoritative; SAS/SATA is legacy taxonomy and Locate/raw controls are non-source substitutions.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; OEM LED table, mapping and insertion procedure gate execution.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind NVMe bay topology, Present LED state/timing, insertion support/operator and recovery.
pending.unlock_condition: No Engineering Decision remains; missing OEM/mapping/safety inputs prevent execution/PASS.

project_authority: OEM LED semantics and hardware insertion/topology are project inputs.
